title: plato-import v1 (dishes)
description: The file an AI assistant produces for AHT Fitness 'Importar recetas'. Reference ingredients by fdc_id from the 'Lista para IA (JSON)' export. Never write nutrition numbers: the app computes them (any that are sent are ignored). One file = up to 50 dishes.

serving_unit.description: What ONE serving is: taco, pieza, taza, porción, plato…

multi_serving.description: true when the dish is naturally multiplied (a diet can say x 3). Amounts below are for ONE serving.

fdc_id.description: From the ingredient export. Never guess a name.

name.description: Optional, for people reading the file; ignored when matching.

unit.description: 'g', 'ml' (only if has_density), or a portion label copied EXACTLY from that ingredient's portions.
